sections.prose:
Data-Spike: When this model makes a melee attack with its Omnissian Axe against an enemy Vehicle, increase that attack's Strength characteristic to 10, it's Armour Piercing characteristic to -3, and its Damage characteristic 4.

Doctrina Maxima: Friendly Skitarii units who were activated for a Doctrina Imperative by this model gain the following additional benefits:

  • If Conqueror Imperative is active, Ranged weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability, or increase [X] by 1 for Ranged weapons that already possess the Sustained Hits [X] ability.
  • If Protector Imperative is active, models in the unit increase their Armour Save characteristic to 2+.

Reparatory Protocol: While this model is within 3" of a friendly unit with the Servitor keyword, it may use this ability. During your Command Phase, return D3 lost wounds to a Servitor model in an eligible unit, or, return 1 destroyed model from that unit to the battlefield.
